title: AuditTrailEntry
description: One entry of the trail, as the client sees it — shared by `GET /audit-entries` (plan 03) and `GET /permission-rules/:ruleId/invocations` (plan 15, B-11), which reads the same entries filtered by `ruleId`. The owner is not here: it is always the caller.

toolName.description: The engine's own name of the tool, kept beside the kind.

kind.description: The canonical kind of the call — `shell`, `file.edit` (plan 28, B-33).

input.description: Exactly as the tool was called — except a `file.read`, which shows its path and window alone. Open: shaped by the tool, never fixed.

traceId.description: What leads from the entry to the log and the events of the same turn.

verdict.description: What was decided. `null` on a `recorded` entry, and on a decision written before the trail kept one.
